A creature of the Verdant Margin that has developed layered, bark-like scales hardened by Rift minerals. It was once a simpler beast, but the Margin's accelerated evolution has turned it into a living fortress, patrolling the deeper parts of the Margin where sunlight is only a rumor.
## Traits
**Hold Breath.** 15 minutes.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Two melee attacks: one bite and one of claws or javelin, or two javelin.
**Bite.** +4 to hit, 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
**Claws.** +4 to hit, 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing.
**Javelin.** +4 to hit, 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
